high_level_description: This image captures a cozy and elegant café setting. The focal point is a beautifully presented croissant on a white plate with an orange rim, placed on a marble table. The croissant is golden brown, glossy, and topped with sliced almonds, giving it a luxurious appearance. Next to the croissant is a cup of coffee from "ANGELINA," a well-known French patisserie and café chain, as indicated by the branding on the cup. The coffee has a latte art design on top.
